items.explanation: The CLO asks for relational database schema design and normalization, which belongs to database systems, not to the Java programming fundamentals this course (title, description and year level) teaches; it also introduces a performance (3NF normalization) well beyond an introductory programming course. The competency does not belong to this course's subject, so the CLO must be rewritten in this subject.

Hands-on practice of the ILO verb, a demonstration and scaffolding.
A recall quiz does not show that students can develop and test a program.
A bare value name says nothing about what students do.
The title concerns the course subject.
